row:
Moving Munchkins is an educational space for parents to learn about their baby's movement milestones. Dr. Hope Reyes PT, DPT is a pediatric physical therapist with over 10 years working with children of all ages and abilities. 
Learn everything from tummy time to how to get your munchkin walking! Learn how to take an active role in encouraging your baby to master the next milestone with research-based playtime activities.
